notes:
Summary: SMB inbound lead (self-serve hosted API). Primary stack: React web widget + serverless proxy (Vercel). Goal: ship helpful in-app support assistant + searchable KB. Current pain: latency variability and occasional 504s for West Coast end users. Wants guidance on region choice, timeout settings, and prompt-length best practices.

Customer quotes / snippets: 
- CTO (J. Patel): "Main customer path needs <200ms median for message generation, otherwise UX degrades."
- PM (L. Gomez): "We prioritized hosted API to avoid infra ops; cost is sensitive at scale."

Tech notes from 3/2 call: 
- Test setup: SSE streaming off by default; single-turn generation with 1.2k token system+prompt occasionally spikes to 700-900ms in us-west-2.
- Observed: us-east-1 median ~= 160-210ms, us-west-2 median ~= 240-520ms depending on token length. Mobile browser adds ~100ms due to TLS handshake.
- Errors: Frontend reports sporadic 504 after 10s timeout from serverless proxy (default Vercel timeout boundary).

Recommendations provided (short): 
- Region: Recommend defaulting to us-east-1 for PebbleGrove's primary user base (east coast majority). Offer guidance to fallback to nearest region for west-coast users; enable geo-routing in app.
- Timeouts: Increase serverless proxy timeout or use streaming to keep connections alive. For long prompts set client-side request timeout to 30s and serverless to 60s where possible; implement retries with exponential backoff (start 300ms, max 3 retries).
- Prompt hygiene: trim KB context; use chunked retrieval + reranking to keep prompt to <800 tokens typical. Encourage cache of recent convo turns + prefix caching.
- Streaming: Enable streaming responses to reduce perceived latency; send partial tokens to client immediately.
- Cost/perf levers: suggest sampling top_p/top_k tuning, and evaluate smaller model variant for non-critical summaries.
- Monitoring: Add per-route latency metrics, token counts, and tie to user region; create alert for 95th percentile >500ms.

Customer follow-ups / requests: 
- Asked for a 1-page "Hosted API perf playbook" specific to serverless setups (Vercel/Netlify) — SE to draft.
- Wants sample curl script to test latency across regions (SE provided script link).
- Ops requests short SAML demo and SOC2 confirmation document.

Stitch notes: small, pragmatic playbook will likely clear blockers. If SAML + SOC2 ok, customer will proceed to 3-month paid trial (dedicated not needed).

Next steps logged: 
- SE (Marco) to send perf playbook + sample scripts by 2026-03-12.
- AE (Avery) to set 30m follow-up week of Mar 16 to review test results and confirm SOC2 attachments.
